thread:
henry_support: FYI - VectorFlow (trial) reporting failing embedding uploads since ~02:40 UTC. Customer says renewal review in 7 days and this is blocking their QA pipeline. Can CS pick this up?

rachel_csm: Thanks Henry. Can you paste the last error and confirm org id? Ill draft comms and offer to run a bridge.

henry_support: Org: vectorflow-88. Latest log: ```ERROR embeddings.ingest: 502 Bad Gateway - upstream reset
service=ingest-pool-3 request_id=rv-9f8e7
```

diego_csm: Ill take primary on the outreach. Quick triage question - any signs of degraded model quality or just ingestion errors?

henry_support: Only ingestion failures reported from their SDKs and our ingestion worker traces. No content quality issues.

anya_sre: Initial ops note: ingest-pool-3 showing sustained 5xxs and OOM-kill in the pod around the spike. Node autoscaler didn't provision extra nodes - we've hit the policy limit. Also seeing elevated EBS write latency in the region. Opening incident.

rachel_csm: Proposed comms plan from CS: 1) Immediate acknowledgment within 20m, include apology and pledge to not charge for failed uploads. 2) Offer a short troubleshooting bridge within 45m. 3) After triage, deliver written RCA + remediation timeline and propose a goodwill credit if root cause on our side. 4) Daily status emails until resolved if customer prefers.

henry_support: Customer on Slack: "We’re blocked on CI, will join a call ASAP."

incbot: Incident INC-4672 opened by anya_sre - priority P2 - tags: ingestion, embeddings, vectorflow

anya_sre: Quick findings: pod OOM around 02:41 UTC, node autoscale capped by max-nodes policy, EBS latency spiked to 1200ms. Mitigation in progress: temporarily increase node pool cap + restart ingest-pool-3 with higher memory request.

diego_csm: I'll schedule the bridge and capture VOC: what jobs failed, business impact, and renewal sentiment. If they explicitly mention exploring alternatives, flag renew-risk and ping AE.

rachel_csm: Diego please use this short customer note template: "Hi Alex - thanks for flagging. We’re actively investigating an ingestion issue affecting your uploads. We’ve paused billing for failed uploads and can join a troubleshooting call now. We’ll follow up with a remediation summary and next steps."

diego_csm: Message sent. They confirmed they can join now.

last message by diego_csm: Post-call notes: Customer confirmed blocked pipelines across 4 services, immediate impact: delayed nightly indexing and some feature flags failing for internal QA. Renewal mood: concerned; they’ve paused procurement until reliability is proven. Agreed remediation steps: 1) Ops to raise node pool limit + backfill crashed pods (anya_sre) 2) Eng to triage ingest memory leak hypothesis (runtime team) 3) CS to send formal remediation + credit offer within 24h (rachel_csm) 4) AE involvement if renewal sentiment doesn’t improve (diego_csm). Customer asked for 2x weekly updates until fixed. :white_check_mark:
